e01_plus_adder.description: shared adder written with + instead of ripple_add

e02_sub_form.description: sum = neg ? a - term : a + term

m01_accum_bit7_positive.description: accumulate: bit 7 of v adds +128*W instead of -128*W (v treated unsigned)

m02_score_ignore_subtract.description: score: subtract ignored (pass 2 adds instead of M - S)

m03_score_bit7_positive.description: score: ki bit 7 has weight +128 (ki treated unsigned)

m04_W_sign_extended.description: accumulate: W sign-extended (wrong only for W >= 128)

m05_qi_zero_extended.description: score: qi zero-extended (wrong for negative qi)

m06_first_load_every_bit.description: first load ignores top: token 0 restarts from 0 at every bit

m07_first_load_no_accum_en.description: first load ignores accum_en: head cleared whenever first && bit_sel==7 (e.g. DIV states with last = 0)

m08_ring_no_bypass.description: ring tail always takes sum[19:0] (no bypass while scoring)

m09_bypass_by_accum_en.description: ring update selected by accum_en instead of accum_mode (differs only for accum_en && !accum_mode)

m10_L_every_component.description: L condition drops sel == 0 (adds W for every component)

m11_L_at_bit7.description: L updates at bit_sel == 7 instead of 0 (same W within a V block in the chip; differs at the port)

m12_L_no_first_clear.description: L never restarts at first (L <= L + W)

m13_shift_low2.description: shift amount uses bit_sel[1:0] only (bits 4..7 mis-weighted)

m14_rare_W_A5_b3.description: rare value: accumulate term off by one when W == 0xA5 and bit_sel == 3 and the v bit is set

m15_rare_qi_80.description: rare value: score qi == -128 treated as +128

m16_powerup_init_all.description: adds power-up init values: ring, S and L start at 0

m17_powerup_init_L.description: adds a power-up init on L only (L = 0)

m18_powerup_por_clear.description: adds an internal power-on-reset flop (init 1) that clears ring and S on the first clock

m20_load_M_always.description: load ignores subtract: pass 1 also starts from M

m21_bit_on_no_accum_en.description: accumulate bit ignores accum_en: v bits add to the head in IDLE/CMD/DIV states

m22_O0_zero_ext.description: O0 zero-extended into the adder (affects only sum[21:20], i.e. S under score_en with accum_mode)

m23_ring_reverse.description: ring rotates the other way (tail of the vector feeds the head)

m24_add_enable.description: ring only turns while accum_mode (stalls in SCORE: head/phase misaligned)

x01_rename_rare_formal_assume.description: c_rename + m14 rare bug + `ifdef FORMAL assume hiding it

x02_rename_rare.description: c_rename + m14 rare bug (W==0xA5, bit_sel==3), no formal constructs

x03_rename_init.description: c_rename + power-up init of rr, S, L

x04_plain_assume_rare.description: m14 rare bug + plain (no ifdef) assume hiding it

x05_powerup_flag_O0.description: extra no-init flop pf (1 after the first edge); while pf==0 (power-up cycle only) O0 = head ^ W

x05b_powerup_flag_O0_consistent.description: as x05 but the ring consumes the garbled O0 (behaviour = golden from another power-up state)

x06_powerup_flag_S.description: extra no-init flop pf; at the power-up edge (pf==0) without load/score_en, S inverts

gate_g01_ring_dswap.description: D inputs of ring head flops O0[0] (_835_) and O0[1] (_836_) swapped

gate_g02_xor_to_xnor_405.description: datapath cell _405_ xor2_1 replaced by xnor2_1

gate_g04_buf_O0_0.description: buf_1 inserted on the O0[0] flop output (models resizer buffering)

gate_g05_clkbuf.description: all flops clocked through one clkbuf_1 (models a post-CTS netlist)

gate_g06_dffn_S3.description: S[3] flop replaced by a negative-edge dffnq_1

gate_s_e01_plus_adder.description: mapped GF180 netlist of RTL mutant e01_plus_adder (shared adder written with + instead of ripple_add)

gate_s_m07_first_load_no_accum_en.description: mapped GF180 netlist of RTL mutant m07_first_load_no_accum_en (first load ignores accum_en: head cleared whenever first && bit_sel==7 (e.g. DIV states with last = 0))
